## Overview Extend the ROCm `QkNormRopeKvCacheFusionPass` so the gated Qwen3.5-family attention prologue (`attn_output_gate`, GemmaRMSNorm, interleaved MRoPE) runs as one launch of AITER's Triton `fused_qkv_split_qk_norm_rope_cache` kernel, and fix two gaps in the existing MRoPE path (K was not returned for backends that read it from the argument; the shuffled KV layout flag was never forwarded). Ungated MRoPE models keep the existing HIP kernel. Requires the companion AITER kernel change (MRoPE sections, shuffle KV layout, optional gate / V outputs); without it the gated pattern is not registered and nothing changes: https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6779 ## Claims - With `-cc.pass_config.fuse_qk_norm_rope_kvcache=True` (default `rope_kvcache_fusion_max_token_num=256`), each Qwen3.8 full-attention layer runs one fused kernel per decode step instead of q/k RMSNorm + MRoPE + `reshape_and_cache`; at 64 tokens: 22.6 µs → 4.88 µs per-layer, 848 kernels → 784 kernels per-step - MRoPE models whose attention backend reads K from the argument (ROCM_AITER_FA prefill) now get the normed, rotated K (`k_out`) when the fusion covers prefill ranges; previously the raw K view was returned (GSM8K dropped to 0.55 at `max_token_num=8192` before this fix). ## Validation A/B on one MI355X in the `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` image of 2026-10-05 (vLLM 92044241a0, aiter 0.1.24.post1 + the companion AITER kernel): - `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True` on both sides, plain KV layout - ISL=1024, OSL=1024, random prompts - `num_requests=10*concurrency` | Concurrency | Total tok/s | Mean TPOT (ms) | Mean TTFT (ms) | |--|--|--|--| | 4 | 702.1 → 701.1 (−0.1%) | 11.20 → 11.21 (+0.1%) | 204.8 → 211.8 (+3.4%) | | 16 | 2016.7 → 2145.7 (+6.4%) | 15.29 → 14.33 (−6.3%) | 603.9 → 612.9 (+1.5%) | | 32 | 3402.0 → 3476.8 (+2.2%) | 17.92 → 17.51 (−2.3%) | 931.6 → 937.7 (+0.7%) | | 64 | 5215.4 → 5346.9 (+2.5%) | 23.49 → 22.91 (−2.5%) | 1088.8 → 1063.9 (−2.3%) | Before: After: GSM8K (lm_eval local-completions, 5-shot, n = 1319, greedy, flexible / strict): - Main: 0.7339 / 0.7058 - PR: 0.7248 / 0.7013. Tests: - `tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_qk_norm_rope_kvcache_fusion.py` gains the gated + Gemma pattern (Qwen3.8 geometry: 24/4 heads of 256, rotary 64, 5 and 2048 tokens, plain and shuffled KV layout) and a case that observes K through a non-attention consumer - The existing MRoPE cases run unchanged. - The whole file passes on MI355X (1020 / 1020). The gated cases skip until the installed AITER has the companion kernel. Reproduce: ``` # Serve vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA --language-model-only --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \ -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True -cc.pass_config.fuse_qk_norm_rope_kvcache=True # Bench vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency 64 --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 ``` ## Details The pass already fused QK-norm + MRoPE + cache write for dense-Q MRoPE models through `QkNormMRopeKvCachePattern`. The Qwen3.5-family prologue differs in three ways: - **`gated_q`**: with `attn_output_gate` the projection has `2·q_size` Q columns and each head is packed `[q | gate]`; the model views `[T, H, 2D]` and `chunk(2)`s, so Q is a strided view. The pattern mirrors the model's split and returns the gate as an output so `attn_output · sigmoid(gate)` stays attached. The Triton kernel reads the packed QKV directly (`gated_qkv_layout="interleaved"`), writes Q and K into the op's buffers and skips its own gate and V copies (`return_gate=False`, `return_v=False`). - **`gemma_norm`**: the q/k norms are `GemmaRMSNorm`, which is the Triton kernel's norm. The pass registers both norm forms for the existing HIP path and the gated form for Gemma only; `_extra_check` rejects a plain-norm match whose weight is a wildcard-bound intermediate of another dtype. - **`k_out`**: parity with the RoPE op. The fused op writes K to the cache; ROCM_AITER_FA's prefill consumes K from the tensor argument, so the replacement must return the normed, rotated K rather than the raw view. The old `_extra_check` guard that restricted K's consumers assumed every attention op reads the cache and is removed. `rocm_aiter_ops.do_qk_norm_mrope_kvcache_update` dispatches gated layers to the Triton kernel; the gated patterns are registered only when the installed AITER's kernel signature has the new arguments. Also forwarded: `use_shuffle_layout` (was hard-coded `False`). `fx_eliminate_noop_reshapes` normalizes the traced pattern the way `NoOpEliminationPass` normalizes the model graph (reshape-of-reshape, shape-preserving reshape), without which the gated split's view/chunk/reshape chain never matches. The `ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN` backend only gains the keyword parameters on its existing hook override (necessary plumbing, exercised by the pass test). With the flag on, unfused ranges run the `rotary_embedding` custom op (forced by this pass) instead of Inductor's fused RoPE (which explains the TTFT increases for some concurrencies); matching the native MRoPE decomposition instead is a follow-up. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

@@ -336,6 +337,62 @@ def forward(
         return QKNormRoPEKVCacheTestModel.forward(self, qkv, positions)
 
 
+class QKNormMRoPEGatedGemmaTestModel(QKNormMRoPEKVCacheTestModel):
+    """Qwen3.5 prologue: [q | gate] heads, GemmaRMSNorm, MRoPE, sigmoid(gate) output."""
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        self.qkv_width = 2 * self.q_size + 2 * self.kv_size
+        eps = self.q_norm.variance_epsilon
+        self.q_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(self.head_size, eps=eps)
+        self.k_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(self.head_size, eps=eps)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            self.q_norm.weight.normal_(std=0.1)
+            self.k_norm.weight.normal_(std=0.1)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, qkv: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        qkv = qkv.clone()
+        q_gate, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size * 2, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        orig_shape = q_gate.shape[:-1]
+        q_gate = q_gate.view(*orig_shape, self.num_heads, -1)
+        q, gate = torch.chunk(q_gate, 2, dim=-1)
+        q = q.reshape(*orig_shape, -1)
+        gate = gate.reshape(*orig_shape, -1)
+
+        q = self.q_norm(q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_size)).view(
+            -1, self.q_size
+        )
+        k = self.k_norm(k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size)).view(
+            -1, self.kv_size
+        )
+        q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+
+        q = q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_size)
+        k = k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size)
+        v = v.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size)
+        kv_cache_dummy_dep = torch.ops.vllm.unified_kv_cache_update(
+            k, v, _encode_layer_name(self.layer_name)
+        )
+        output = torch.empty(
+            q.shape[0],
+            self.num_heads * self.head_size,
+            device=q.device,
+            dtype=self.dtype,
+        )
+        torch.ops.vllm.unified_attention_with_output(
+            q,
+            k,
+            v,
+            output,
+            _encode_layer_name(self.layer_name),
+            kv_cache_dummy_dep=kv_cache_dummy_dep,
+        )
+        # The gate must stay live (as in the model) for the pattern to match.
+        return q, output * torch.sigmoid(gate), v, kv_cache_dummy_dep
+
